description: Search CMS Open Payments general payments (Sunshine Act) -- pharmaceutical/device company payments to doctors and teaching hospitals. Filter by company, doctor surname, state, specialty, and year. Returns payment amount, type (food/travel/consulting/gift/royalty), drug/device name, and recipient details. 15M+ records per year.
